skill.name: video-downloader
skill.description: Guides permitted video downloads from YouTube and other platforms with quality, format, playlist, and metadata options.
skill.summary: Download permitted videos, audio, playlists, and metadata for offline use.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: The external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, and the hardcoded URLs are documentation examples. The remaining concern is business-logic abuse because the skill enables video platform downloads and needs stronger permission and policy checks.

remediation.suggestion: Require users to confirm they own the content or have explicit permission before any download starts.

remediation.issue: Platform compliance boundaries are too broad.
remediation.suggestion: State that the skill must not bypass DRM, paywalls, private content, rate limits, or platform restrictions.

remediation.issue: Large downloads can create local resource risk.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for a destination folder, quality limit, and storage limit before playlist or batch downloads.

content.value_statement: Online videos can be hard to review when connections are unreliable or content changes. This skill guides allowed downloads, quality choices, audio extraction, playlists, and organized saved files.
actual_capabilities: Guides single video downloads from YouTube and other platforms.
Supports quality choices such as 480p, 720p, 1080p, and 4K.
Handles MP4, WebM, and audio-only requests.
Supports playlist and batch download requests.
Preserves metadata such as title, description, and thumbnail.
limitations: Users must have rights or permission before downloading content.
Actual downloading depends on available tools, network access, and platform restrictions.
It should not bypass DRM, paywalls, private content, or access controls.
Large playlists can require significant time, bandwidth, and disk space.

use_cases.title: Offline Lesson Review
use_cases.description: Save permitted tutorials for travel, classrooms, or low-bandwidth study sessions.

use_cases.title: Research Video Archive
use_cases.description: Keep allowed conference talks, webinars, and reference videos with useful metadata.

use_cases.title: Creator Backup
use_cases.description: Download your own published videos with thumbnails for editing, backup, or reuse.

prompt_templates.title: Download One Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this video for offline viewing: [URL]. Use the best MP4 quality available.

prompt_templates.title: Save Audio Only
prompt_templates.prompt: Download the audio from [URL] as MP3. Save it with the video title.

prompt_templates.title: Download a Playlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this playlist: [URL]. Use 720p MP4 and save thumbnails when available.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Download With Limits
prompt_templates.prompt: Download these permitted videos: [URLs]. Use 1080p when available, skip files above [SIZE], and summarize saved filenames.

output_examples.input: Download this permitted conference talk in 1080p.
output: Selected 1080p MP4 because it is available.
Saved the video and thumbnail to the chosen downloads folder.
Reported the final filename, duration, and file size.

output_examples.input: Save the audio from this lecture as MP3.
output: Extracted the audio-only version from the supplied video.
Named the file using the video title.
Confirmed the saved MP3 location and duration.

output_examples.input: Download these three allowed training videos in 720p.
output: Processed each link as a batch request.
Listed completed files and any skipped items.

best_practices: Confirm you own the video or have permission before downloading.
Choose a lower resolution when storage or bandwidth is limited.
Use a dedicated folder for downloads, thumbnails, and metadata.
anti_patterns: Trying to bypass DRM, paywalls, private links, or access controls.
Starting large playlist downloads without checking available storage.

faq.question: Does this skill download videos by itself?
faq.answer: It guides the AI tool through download requests. Actual downloads require compatible tools, network access, and platform permission.

faq.question: Can I use it for YouTube videos?
faq.answer: Yes, for videos you are allowed to download and use. Follow YouTube terms and local laws.

faq.question: Can it download playlists?
faq.answer: It supports playlist requests and batch lists. Large playlists may take longer and use more storage.

faq.question: Can it save audio only?
faq.answer: Yes, it can request audio-only output such as MP3 when the available tooling supports conversion.

faq.question: Does it keep thumbnails and metadata?
faq.answer: The instructions include preserving title, description, and thumbnail when possible.

faq.question: What should I avoid?
faq.answer: Do not use it to bypass DRM, download private content, or redistribute copyrighted media without rights.
